project_type: Node.js CLI application - Browser-automated mining tool
build_system: npm with no build step (plain JS, no transpilation)
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm install. 2. Run node src/index.js --help. 3. Verify wallet derivation works. 4. Verify keplr mock generates valid script.
setup_instructions: 1. cd /projects/sandbox/JAY-Mining. 2. npm install. 3. Copy .env.example to .env and set MNEMONIC. 4. Run node src/index.js.
environment_constraints: Node.js v18.20.8. Full network access (OPEN_INTERNET). Puppeteer with Chrome already installed from previous feature.
key_patterns: CommonJS modules, chalk@4 for colored output, dotenv for config, @cosmjs/amino for wallet derivation.
